root_cause_analysis.direction_finding: The Ofd LowCode plugin converts OFD FORMAT (Chinese Open Fixed-layout Document) INPUT to PDF output — not PDF to OFD. API type found: OfdToPdfOptions (ctors: 1).
root_cause_analysis.catalog_type_found: Aspose.Pdf.LowCode.OfdToPdfOptions (ctors: 1) — converts FROM OFD, not TO OFD
root_cause_analysis.obfuscated_internal_names: Catalog shows obfuscated internal type names; OfdToPdfOptions confirmed by reflection
root_cause_analysis.what_is_missing: No OfdOptions class that would convert PDF -> OFD format. The plugin direction is OFD->PDF only.
root_cause_analysis.input_fixture_required: An actual .ofd file is required as input. Programmatic OFD creation not possible via Aspose.Pdf namespace — OFD is a closed format requiring specialized tooling.
root_cause_analysis.ofd_format_notes: OFD (GB/T 33190-2016) is a Chinese national standard document format. No open tooling exists for programmatic OFD fixture generation in .NET.
